articles.title: Iran executes man on Israel spying charges: judiciary
articles.mainIdea: Iran executes man on Israel spying charges: judiciary
articles.summary: AFP: Iran executes man on Israel spying charges: judiciary. Iran on Wednesday hanged a man convicted of spying for its arch enemy Israel, the judiciary said, the latest such execution on espionage charges in a trend that has troubled rights groups.He said that 12 people had now been executed on charges of spying for Israel since the June war broke out.

articles.title: Ex-CIA agent convicted of spying for Soviets dies in prison
articles.mainIdea: Ex-CIA agent convicted of spying for Soviets dies in prison
articles.summary: AFP: Ex-CIA agent convicted of spying for Soviets dies in prison. Aldrich Ames, the Central Intelligence Agency spy who was sentenced to life in prison for selling secrets to Moscow, costing the lives of a dozen double agents, died Monday in custody, US authorities said.Ames worked as a counterintelligence analyst for the CIA for 31 years and, along with his wife Rosario, was convicted of selling information to the Soviet Union between 1985 and 1993 -- compromising secret missions and costing lives -- in exchange for more than $2.5 million.

articles.title: Overseas scholars drawn to China's scientific clout, funding
articles.mainIdea: Overseas scholars drawn to China's scientific clout, funding
articles.summary: AFP: Overseas scholars drawn to China's scientific clout, funding. China's government has long made efforts to tempt top scientists from abroad, but researchers say its institutions themselves are increasingly attracting talent thanks to their generous funding and growing prestige.Four of the top five leading research institutions in natural and health sciences in 2025 were Chinese, according to an index by the journal Nature.
